name: Summary
purpose: A key/value list for confirming details before or after an action (a payment review, a receipt). Name on the left (text/secondary), value on the right (text/default, tabular-nums), hairline dividers between rows, with an optional emphasised total row. Surfaced as a missing pattern by the journey gap report.

props.name: total
props.$note: Emphasise the final row as a total (heavier weight, larger size).

variants.name: with-total
variants.use: Adds an emphasised total row as the last row.

accessibility.role: Semantic <dl>/<dt>/<dd> so assistive tech announces each name→value pair as a group (1.3.1). Each row wraps one dt+dd in a div.
accessibility.screenReader: REVIEW (inferred): confirm amounts read naturally (e.g. '£250.00' as 'two hundred and fifty pounds'); the value carries meaning, not its right-alignment.

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): using a <table> for a simple two-column name/value list — a description list (dl) is the correct structure.
REVIEW (inferred): centre-aligning values — keep keys left / values right so amounts align on a common edge.
REVIEW (inferred): conveying the total only by size — it must also read as 'Total' in the key (1.3.1).

tokenValidation.against: canon token store (semantic-colour.json); declared values match in light + dark (passes _validate_snippets).
tokenValidation.result: PASS (colour); no open token questions (reuses divider/border/subsection).

provenance.$note: REVIEW: no Figma node yet — surfaced by the journey gap report (the .c-summary hand-util). Needs a design owner + Figma source before promotion from candidate to gated.
